english.title: Enter into activities circumventing requirements imposed by Treasury - Counter-Terrorism Act 2008
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person to whom a direction had been given under paragraph 3 of Schedule 7 to the Counter-Terrorism Act 2008, intentionally participated in activities, namely **(..SPECIFY ACTIVITIES..), knowing that the object or effect of them was to circumvent a requirement, namely **(..SPECIFY REQUIREMENT..), imposed by a direction under that Schedule
